info.name: Pulzion-EMS-User
info.description: User-role tests for pulzion-26-ems-backend. Import + select Pulzion-local env. Run in folder order: Health > Auth > Events > Registration > Cart > Transaction > Slots > Misc. Auth uses Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (see middlewares/userMiddlewares.js isAuthenticated). Prefer /user/app/* routes to bypass recaptcha. Admin folders 9-13 use Authorization: Bearer {{adminToken}} (see middlewares/adminMiddlewares.js isAdminAuthenticated, role=admin). Run 9-Admin-Auth signin first to auto-save {{adminToken}}.

item.name: 2-Auth
item.description: Order: app/signup (201, no token) > email-verify (saves {{token}}) > app/signin. Signup auto-saves {{loginEmail}}; paste OTP from server logs into {{signupOtp}}. Unverified signin returns 403 with otpSent flag. Web signup/signin need real recaptchaToken.

exec: pm.test("signup 201, no token until verified", function () {
pm.test("signin 200 + token (403 if unverified - run email-verify first)", function () {
pm.test("resend reachable (200 sent/skipped, 400 already-verified)", function () { pm.expect([200, 400, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
// Expect 400 Invalid Recaptcha with dummy token - proves route is live
pm.test("web signup reachable (201 or 400 recaptcha)", function () {
pm.test("no token -> 401", function () {}); // duplicate request without header to verify 401 manually
pm.test("otp sent or user-not-found", function () { pm.expect([200, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

item.name: 4-Registration
item.description: POST with freeEventId -> direct registration + ticket. POST with paidEventId -> added to cart.

item.name: 5-Cart
item.description: Test with paidEventId. Run emptyCart last in this folder.

exec: pm.test("add to cart 201 (409 dup / 400 free-event / 403 CodeX)", function () { pm.expect([201, 400, 403, 404, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test("get cart 200 or 404 empty", function () { pm.expect([200, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
var j = pm.response.json(); if (j.offers && j.offers.length) pm.environment.set("comboId", j.offers[0].id);

item.name: 6-Transaction
item.description: Re-add to cart first if you emptied it. POST clears cart on success.

item.name: 7-Slots
item.description: Requires prior registration (user_event row). GET slots?event_id first to get slotId.

exec: var j = pm.response.json(); if (j.slots && j.slots.length) pm.environment.set("slotId", j.slots[0].id);

pm.test("leaderboard 200 + shape", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); var b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.leaderboard).to.be.an("array"); if (b.leaderboard.length) { pm.expect(b.leaderboard[0]).to.have.all.keys("full_name", "points"); } });

item.name: 9-Admin-Auth
item.description: Admin auth (server/routes/adminRoutes.js, mounted at /admin in app.js). Signin first - auto-saves {{adminToken}}. All other admin folders need Authorization: Bearer {{adminToken}} (middlewares/adminMiddlewares.js isAdminAuthenticated, role=admin). POST /admin/signup exists in controller but is commented out in routes - create admin via DB/seed, then signin here.

exec: pm.test("eventRegister reachable (200 accepted / 400 rejected-or-dup / 404 no-form)", function () { pm.expect([200, 400, 401, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test("signout 200 (run LAST, clears nothing server-side)", function () { pm.expect([200, 401]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

item.name: 10-Admin-Events
item.description: Event CRUD (server/routes/AdminEventRoutes.js, mounted at /admin_events). POST + PUT need admin auth. GET all + GET by id are public. DELETE /:id is commented out in routes (controllers/adminEventControllers.js deleteEvent exists but unreachable) - no request included.

exec: var j = pm.response.json(); if (j && j.event && j.event.id) pm.environment.set("eventId", j.event.id);

item.name: 11-Admin-Combos
item.description: Combo CRUD (server/routes/adminComboRoutes.js, mounted at /admin_combo). All need admin auth.

exec: var j = pm.response.json(); if (j.combo && j.combo.length) pm.environment.set("comboId", j.combo[0].id);
pm.test("delCombo 200 (404 unknown, run LAST)", function () { pm.expect([200, 401, 404, 500]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

item.name: 12-Admin-Dashboard
item.description: Read-only stats (server/routes/adminDashboardRoutes.js, mounted at /dashboard). All need admin auth.

item.name: GET dashboard registeration (note typo in route)
13-Admin-Slots
item.description: Slot CRUD (server/routes/adminslotcrud.js, mounted at /slots in app.js). POST + DELETE + GET /users need admin auth. GET / query (event_id/slot_id/capacity/start_time/end_time) has NO auth middleware in code. Admin mail routes (/admin_mail) have both handlers commented out - no live routes, omitted.

item.name: GET slots by event_id (public in code)

exec: var j = pm.response.json(); var s = j.slots || (j.slot ? [j.slot] : []); if (s.length && s[0].id) pm.environment.set("slotId", s[0].id);

item.name: GET slots by slot_id (public in code)

exec: pm.test("slot by id reachable", function () { pm.expect([200, 500]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
var j = pm.response.json(); if (j && j.slot && j.slot.id) pm.environment.set("slotId", j.slot.id);
pm.test("delete slot reachable (200 / 400 not-found)", function () { pm.expect([200, 400, 401, 500]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

item.name: DELETE slots by event_id (deletes ALL slots of event)

exec: pm.test("delete by event reachable - run LAST, destructive", function () { pm.expect([200, 400, 401, 500]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
